releasenotes: Topic pages in the REST API for moderators: with hidden=1 (the mobile app among others), MariaDB picked the date index of the whole forum for the first and the last pages of a large topic. The plugin now leaves out only that one index for exactly this query: 0.1-1.9 s -> 0.3-1.4 ms with 0.5 million posts, 2-14 s -> 0.5 ms with 3.2 million. The same posts in the same order; the usual API query (hidden=0) stays as it is. Part of the "Pages of large topics" switch.
